notes_list.title: 🎼 Gwalior Gharana
notes_list.basic_overview:
📍 Madhya Pradesh | Sabse purana khayal gharana (Oldest)
✍️ Sansthapak: Haddu Khan, Hassu Khan, Nathu Khan (Nathan Pir Bakhsh ki parampara)
⭐ Prasiddh: Ustad Amjad Ali Khan, Vishnu Digambar Paluskar
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Gwalior = pehla/oldest. 'Haddu-Hassu-Nathu' teen bhai gwale ki tarah dudh bechte the. Amjad (sarod) + Paluskar dono Gwalior se.

notes_list.title: 🎼 Indore Gharana
notes_list.basic_overview: ⭐ Prasiddh: Ustad Amir Khan
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Indore ka 'Amir' sheher → Amir Khan.

notes_list.title: 🎼 Banaras Gharana
notes_list.basic_overview: ⭐ Prasiddh: Ustad Bismillah Khan, Pt. Ravi Shankar, Pt. Shiv Kumar, Pt. Kishan Maharaj, Pt. Anokhelal, Pt. Kanthe Maharaj
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Banaras = Shiv ki nagri → Shiv Kumar. Ganga ghat par 'Bismillah' bolke shehnai → Bismillah Khan. Maharaj log (Kishan, Kanthe) tabla ke Maharaj.

notes_list.title: 🎼 Rampur-Sahaswan Gharana
notes_list.basic_overview:
✍️ Sansthapak: Ustad Inayat Hussain Khan
⭐ Prasiddh: Ustad Rashid Khan, Ghulam Mustafa Khan, Mehboob Khan, Asad Ali Khan
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Rampur ka Rashid → R-R (Rampur–Rashid). Inayat = 'inayat' (meherbani) karke gharana shuru kiya.

notes_list.title: 🎼 Delhi Gharana
notes_list.basic_overview: ⭐ Prasiddh: Ustad Mamman Khan, Ustad Tanras Khan, Sabu Khan, Ustad Iqbal Ahmad Khan
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Dilli ka 'Iqbal' buland hai → Iqbal Ahmad Khan. Tanras = Tan + ras → Delhi ke tabla/gayaki ki ras.

notes_list.title: 🎼 Patiala Gharana
notes_list.basic_overview:
✍️ Sansthapak: Ali Baksh & Fateh Ali Khan
⭐ Prasiddh: Bade Ghulam Ali Khan (20vi sadi ka Tansen)
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Patiala peg = BADA peg → 'Bade' Ghulam Ali, 'Bade' Fateh Ali. Bade log = 20vi sadi ke Tansen.

notes_list.title: 🎼 Mewati Gharana
notes_list.basic_overview:
⭐ Prasiddh: Pt. Jasraj
📌 Sansthapak: Ghagge Nazir Khan
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Mewat → 'Mewa' khao to 'Jas' (yash) milega → Pt. Jasraj.

notes_list.title: 🎼 Jaipur-Atrauli Gharana
notes_list.basic_overview:
✍️ Sansthapak: Alladiya Khan
⭐ Prasiddh: Kishori Amonkar, Mallikarjun Mansur, Mogubai Kurdikar
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Kishore Kumar ke 'atrangi' gaane → Kishori Amonkar → Jaipur-Atrauli (Atrauli = atrangi). Mallika + Arjun → Mallikarjun Mansur.

notes_list.title: 🎼 Maihar Gharana
notes_list.basic_overview:
✍️ Sansthapak: Baba Allauddin Khan
⭐ Prasiddh: Ali Akbar Khan, Pt. Ravi Shankar
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Maihar = Maa ka ghar → 'Baba' (pita samaan) Allauddin ne sikhaya → beta Ali Akbar. Maihar me Ali Akbar (sarod) aur Ravi Shankar (sitar) dono.

notes_list.title: 🎼 Mandi (Bhendi) Bazaar Gharana
notes_list.basic_overview:
✍️ Sansthapak: Chhajju Khan, Nazir Khan, Khadim Hussain Khan
⭐ Prasiddh: Ustad Amanat Ali, Lata Mangeshkar, Anjanibai Malpekar
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Mandi Bazaar me 'Chhajju' sabzi bech raha tha, Lata Mangeshkar ne Amanat (jama) ki → Chhajju Khan, Amanat Ali, Lata.

notes_list.title: 🎼 Bettiah Gharana
notes_list.basic_overview:
📍 Bihar | Dhrupad gharana
⭐ Prasiddh: Indra Kishore Mishra
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Bettiah = 'Betiya' → Indra ki Betiya → Indra Kishore Mishra (dhrupad).

notes_list.title: 🎼 Kirana Gharana
notes_list.basic_overview:
✍️ Sansthapak: Abdul Karim Khan (Abdul Wahid Khan bhi)
⭐ Prasiddh: Pt. Bhimsen Joshi, Gangubai Hangal, Dr. Prabha Atre
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Kirana store se Gangubai ne cream li, Prabha ne neem li → Gangubai Hangal, Prabha Atre. Bhimsen = Bheem jaisi taakat wali awaaz. Abdul KARIM = KIRANA (K-K).

notes_list.title: 🎼 Agra Gharana
notes_list.basic_overview:
✍️ Sansthapak: Haji Sujan Khan (Tansen ke damad)
⭐ Prasiddh: Faiyaz Khan, Ghagge Khuda Baksh, Tahawwur Hussain, S.R. Vyas, Mohsin Niyazi
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Agra me 'Sujan' (sujaan = samajhdaar) damad mila Tansen ko → Haji Sujan Khan. Agra ka Faiyaz = 'fayda' dene wala.

notes_list.title: 🥁 Tabla
notes_list.basic_overview:
⭐ Zakir Hussain: Padma Shri (1988), Padma Bhushan (2002), Padma Vibhushan (2023); Global Drum Project ke liye Grammy
👨 Pita: Allah Rakha (Punjab gharana)
🥁 Anya: Ustad Tafu Khan, Pt. Kishan Maharaj, Ahmad Jan Thirakwa, Anindo Chatterjee, Swapan Chaudhuri, Gyan Prakash Ghosh, Sandeep Das
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: 88-02-23 → Shri-Bhushan-Vibhushan (har 'Zakir' hua badaa). 'Allah Rakha' (Allah bachaye) → pita. Global Drum = Grammy. Sandeep Das → 'Das' ka bal (tabla).

notes_list.title: 🎸 Sitar
notes_list.basic_overview:
⭐ Nikhil Banerjee, Shahid Parvez, Pt. Ravi Shankar, Anushka Shankar, Arvind Parikh, Smita Nagdev, Vilayat Khan
📌 Vishnunarayan Bhatkhande: Sanketan Pranali (notation)
🏆 Bharat Ratna (Sangeet): M.S. Subbulakshmi 1998, Ravi Shankar 1999, Bismillah Khan 2001, Bhimsen Joshi 2009
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Bharat Ratna order → SuBBu (98), RaVi (99), BiSmillah (01), BhimSen (09) = 98-99-01-09. Ravi + Anushka Shankar = Shankar family sitar.

notes_list.title: 🎶 Santoor
notes_list.basic_overview: ⭐ Pt. Shivkumar Sharma, Bhajan Sopori, Rahul Sharma, Pt. Ulhas Bapat, Tarun Bhattacharya
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: SANTOOR = SANT → Shiv (Sant) Kumar. Sopori = Soap (ri) se saaf santoor. Rahul bhi Sant ka beta. Bapat = 'Bap re Bap'. Sant + Sopori + Sharma = santoor.

notes_list.title: 🪈 Bansuri (Flute)
notes_list.basic_overview: ⭐ Pt. Hariprasad Chaurasia, Pannalal Ghosh, Raghunath Seth, T.R. Mahalingam, Sikkil Mala Chandrashekhar, K. Bhaskaran, Sarasvati Ammal
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Bansuri = Krishna ka kanhaiya → Hari (Krishna) prasad → Hariprasad Chaurasia. Pannalal = Panna (heera) jaisi dhun. Mala = Sikkil Mala (mala pehne Krishna).

notes_list.title: 🎻 Sarangi
notes_list.basic_overview: ⭐ Ustad Bundu Khan, Ustad Shakoor Khan, Pt. Ram Narayan
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Sarangi = 'Sa-rang-i' → sabrang. Bundu = 'Bundi' me sabrang hota hai. Ram Narayan = sabko sikhaya (Narayan sabka).

notes_list.title: 🎷 Shehnai
notes_list.basic_overview: ⭐ Bageshwari Qamar, Daya Shankar, Ali Ahmad Hussain (Bismillah Khan bhi - Banaras)
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Shaadi me kamar dikhake nachte hain → Qamar (kamar) → Bageshwari Qamar. Shehnai = shaadi ka instrument.

notes_list.title: 🪕 Sarod
notes_list.basic_overview: ⭐ Ustad Amjad Ali Khan (Gwalior), Ustad Ali Akbar Khan (Maihar), Buddhadev Dasgupta, Zarin Sharma
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: SAROD = 'A' se shuru: Amjad + Ali Akbar (A-A). Amjad → Gwalior, Ali Akbar → Maihar. Buddhadev = Buddha bhi sarod sunte the.

notes_list.title: 🎶 Sur Bahar
notes_list.basic_overview: ⭐ Annapurna Devi (Maihar gharana)
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Sur ki Bahar = Annapurna (Devi ke haath ka swaad bhi, sur bhi).

notes_list.title: 🪕 Veena
notes_list.basic_overview: ⭐ Sundaram Balachander, Jayanti Kumaresh, Veena Dhanammal, V. Balsara
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: 'Bal ki vaani sundar' → Sundaram Balachander. 'Jai-Jai vaani' → Jayanti. 'Dhan wale ki vaani' → Dhanammal.

notes_list.title: 🪕 Mohan Veena
notes_list.basic_overview: ⭐ Vishwa Mohan Bhatt
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Mohan Veena → Vishwa MOHAN Bhatt (naam me hi Mohan).

notes_list.title: 🥁 Mridangam
notes_list.basic_overview: ⭐ Palghat Mani Iyer, K.V. Prasad, Raja Rao
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Palghat = Pal-ghat par mridangam. Mani Iyer = 'mani' (mridangam ki mani). Prasad lekar dang reh gaye → K.V. Prasad.

notes_list.title: 🎹 Harmonium
notes_list.basic_overview: ⭐ Pt. Purushottam Walawalkar, Appa Jalgaonkar, Gyan Prakash Ghosh
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Harmonium = Hari ka mohan → Purushottam (Vishnu ka naam). Appa ne Jal-gaon me bajaya → Appa Jalgaonkar.
